acceptance_checks.detail: Reason codes are descriptive in-memory evidence only and carry no authority or execution behavior.

acceptance_checks.check_id: DecisionReasonCode is a non-exhaustive in-memory enum with exactly the 11 currently documented known variants: ExactDuplicate, NewerSource, ValidTimeChanged, SourceConflict, LowSourceAuthority, CrossScopeConflict, StaleSource, ExplicitUserOperation, InsufficientEvidence, AmbiguousEntity, and PolicyReviewRequired.
acceptance_checks.detail: DecisionReasonCode is non-exhaustive and defines exactly the 11 currently documented known variants.

acceptance_checks.check_id: DecisionReasonCode supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests prove all 11 known variants are distinct and preserve copy/hash value semantics without defining ordering.
acceptance_checks.detail: The exact allowed value traits are present, ordering is absent, and focused tests execute in the 43/43 workspace pass.

evidence_checks.detail: Exact-head and fresh post-merge standard CI pass Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows.

cargo fmt passes on exact head and canonical main.
